The '''Gelda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Carrion sector/Legends|Carrion sector]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system was connected by the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Delephr system/Legends|Delephr]] and [[Endoraan system/Legends|Endoraan]] systems.<ref name="TEA" />

The Gelda system fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and was a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Geldan sun-apple]]s.<ref name="Riders of the Maelstrom">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Geldan sun-apple]]s|system=Gelda [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gelda system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-4.<ref name="TEA" />
